description: Custom domains for Code Engine apps. create needs a TLS secret (ce_secret action create_tls) and returns the CNAME target to add at your DNS provider. For certificate plus mapping in one step use proc_setup_custom_domain. Call get_schema with name ce_domain_mapping for every action's fields.

action.description: list: List domain mappings. | get: Get one mapping and its CNAME target. Needs domain_name. | create: Map domain_name to app_name using tls_secret. Needs domain_name, app_name, tls_secret. | update: Point the domain at another app or TLS secret. Needs domain_name. | delete: Delete a domain mapping. Needs domain_name.

app_name.description: Code Engine application to route traffic to

project_id.description: Project id or name, from ce_project action list.

tls_secret.description: Name of the TLS secret containing the certificate and key

name: ce_domain_mapping
